survey.welcome_title: Could you qualify for weight loss medication?
survey.welcome_desc: Answer a few quick questions so our doctor can assess whether GLP-1 treatment is right for you. Everything is strictly confidential.
survey.welcome_time: Takes about 2 minutes — your data is handled securely and confidentially.
survey.bmi_qualifies_directly: Based on your BMI, you may qualify directly for medication. Let's continue with a few health questions.
survey.bmi_qualifies_with_conditions: Your BMI is between 27 and 30. You may qualify if you also meet certain health criteria. We'll ask a few more questions next.
survey.attempts_title: What have you already tried to lose weight?
survey.attempts_desc: Select all that apply. This helps our doctor assess medical necessity.
survey.attempts_diets: Diets (keto, calorie restriction, intermittent fasting, etc.)
survey.attempts_none: I haven't tried anything specific yet
survey.comorbid_title: Do you have any of the following conditions?
survey.comorbid_required_notice: Because your BMI is between 27 and 30, at least one related condition is required to qualify for medication.
survey.contra_title: Do any of the following apply to you?
survey.contra_desc: Select all that apply. These questions are essential for your safety.
survey.contra_mtc_men2: I (or a family member) have Medullary Thyroid Carcinoma (MTC) or MEN 2
survey.contra_eating_disorder: I have (had) a severe eating disorder
survey.contact_title: Almost done — just a few more details
survey.contact_desc: So our doctor can reach out to you for a personal consultation.
survey.contact_consent: I consent to the processing of my medical data in accordance with GDPR. My data will only be used for medical assessment by FAB Clinic.
survey.dq_age_desc: Our weight loss treatments are only available for adults aged 18 and over. We recommend discussing options with your general practitioner that are appropriate for your age.
survey.dq_bmi_low_desc: Based on your BMI (below 27), you don't qualify for prescription weight loss medication. This type of medication is only intended for individuals with an elevated health risk due to excess weight. Perhaps our lifestyle coaching programme would be a good fit?
survey.dq_bmi_27_no_comorbidity_desc: Your BMI is between 27 and 30, but you don't have any associated conditions that justify medication. According to prescribing guidelines, medication isn't an option in this case. Please consult your GP for personalised advice.
survey.dq_contraindication_desc: Based on your answers, GLP-1 medication is not safe for you at this time. This isn't a rejection — it's a safety measure. We strongly recommend discussing this with your GP or specialist.

qualified.hero_desc: Based on your answers, you qualify for medically supervised weight loss medication. Our doctors are ready to create a personalised treatment plan with you.
qualified.step1_desc: One of our doctors reviews your intake and discusses the best options with you — by phone or video call.
qualified.step2_desc: Once approved, the doctor prescribes your medication. It's delivered discreetly to your door via our partner pharmacy.
qualified.step3_desc: You receive ongoing support from our team — with regular check-ins and dosage adjustments as needed.
qualified.options_desc: Our doctor will advise which medication best suits your situation. Here's an overview of the options.
qualified.product_ozempic: The most widely prescribed option. Proven effective for medically guided weight loss.
qualified.product_mounjaro: Latest generation. Dual action for optimal results.
qualified.product_wegovy: Specifically developed for long-term weight management.
qualified.trust_1_desc: Every prescription by a registered physician
qualified.trust_3_desc: Free home delivery in neutral packaging
qualified.cta_desc: Schedule your free consultation today and take the first step towards a healthier weight — guided by our doctors.
